messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: problems with installng of Rattle for Windows 32 XP
parts:
Some more information might be useful.  What versions of packages? Try sending the output of

> rattleInfo()

My guess is that you are using an older version of RGtk2. On Windows it is important to use at least version 2.20.17. This install the appropriate GTK+ libraries into a known location.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: d6c0ccf22d99409f
messages.subject: problems with installng of Rattle for Windows 32 XP
parts:
Hi, (repost)

Your problem is in the computer not recognising the RGK2.dll

One fix might be to load R, and then install that package through the install packages option in the R console.

Also, have you looked at the togaware website, as graham, has handy pieces of advice for the different issues with installs

http://rattle.togaware.com/rattle-install-troubleshooting.html

Regards
Tony
